title: Europe seeks to deter Russia after attempted attack in Leipzig
subhead: Hostile acts attributed to Moscow are multiplying across Europe. On September 3, Copenhagen accused Moscow of preparing 'sabotage actions' against Denmark's defense industry. However, European countries remain divided over how to respond.

Paris rents exceed legal limits at record levels
subhead: For the first time since rent control was introduced in 2019, 46% of properties in the French capital were listed above the legal caps, compared to 31% in 2025, according to the annual barometer from a leading housing group.

title: France adopts fairer world map ahead of UN vote on more balanced geography
subhead: As part of a movement led by the African Union, Paris announced on Friday that it will abandon the Mercator projection to better reflect the physical reality of the planet. France will now appear smaller on world maps.

title: Writer Rebecca Solnit still has hope: 'When we show up, we can make the future'
subhead: Ahead of the midterm elections, Solnit calls for progressives to mobilize against Donald Trump in her latest book. She urges readers to reflect on the progress made over the past 70 years to understand the significance of feminist, social and environmental struggles.

title: 'The question of meaning is the first you must ask yourself, even before taking out your camera': Jean-François Leroy, director of Visa pour l'image, pens letter to young photojournalists
subhead: In a book to be published in September, the co-founder and head of the international photojournalism festival in Perpignan, who died on August 31, addresses a letter to young photojournalists, urging them to approach their subjects with a journalistic rather than an aesthetic eye, and to learn from their elders.

title: Sweden, a 'paradise' for the ultra-rich, debates billionaire tax ahead of elections
subhead: Regarded as one of the most egalitarian countries in the world, the number of billionaires in Sweden has continued to rise while poverty has increased. Ahead of the September 13 elections, taxing the wealthiest has become a major campaign issue.
